items.title: AMD: Why investors should take another look
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his take on why investors may want to take another look at AMD (AMD) following CEO Lisa Su's third-quarter earnings call. Sozzi breaks down the key takeaways from Su's comments and update to forward guidance.

items.title: Should AI Revenue Surge Require Action From Palantir (PLTR) Investors?

items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) drew fresh attention after reporting third quarter 2026 results with sales of US$2.31b and net income of US$1.13b, then lifting both fourth quarter and full year revenue guidance.
